description: All sports with live and prematch event counts and whether each is in your plan.

description.name: search_events
description.description: Find events (fixtures) by sport, team or league text, live or prematch. Returns ids, teams, league, start time, score/clock when live. No prices: use get_event or get_*_odds for prices.

description.name: get_live_odds
description.description: Current in-play Pinnacle odds for a sport (decimal + American prices, no-vig fair odds, margin, max stake). Main markets by default.

description.name: get_prematch_odds
description.description: Current prematch (pre-game) Pinnacle odds for a sport, soonest events first. Same fields as get_live_odds.

description.name: get_event
description.description: One event with all its markets and prices by event id.

description.name: get_drops
description.description: Biggest odds drops (prices shortening) in the last N minutes: from/to decimal price and drop %. Useful to spot steam and sharp money.

description.name: get_closing_odds
description.description: Closing odds (last prematch price before kickoff) for an event, for closing-line-value analysis. Builder plan and above.
